def control(obs):
    global points,last_t,last_scan
    t=obs['t']; dt=obs['dt']
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; h=obs['hitch_deg']
    da=v*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))/2.5*dt
    c=math.cos(da); q=math.sin(da)
    points=[((x-v*dt)*c+y*q,-(x-v*dt)*q+y*c,age+dt) for x,y,age in points if age<17]
    for name,view in obs['views'].items():
        if name=='periphery': continue
        ox,oy=view['origin']
        for b,d in view.get('walls',[]):
            b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
            if x<0 and d<18: points.append((x,y,0))
    if len(points)>2200: points=points[-2200:]
    a=math.radians(-h); ca=math.cos(a); sa=math.sin(a)
    rails=[]
    for x,y,age in points:
        x+=1.3
        s=-(x*ca+y*sa); n=-x*sa+y*ca
        if 2<s<14 and abs(n)<7: rails.append((s,n,age))
    def center(s0):
        sides=[]
        for side in [-1,1]:
            vals=[(n-side*2.55,math.exp(-((s-s0)/1.3)**2)*math.exp(-age/9)) for s,n,age in rails if n*side>0.7 and abs(s-s0)<2.5]
            w=sum(z[1] for z in vals)
            if w>0.1: sides.append(sum(n*w for n,w in vals)/w)
        return sum(sides)/len(sides) if sides else None
    e=center(8.0); near=center(5.5); far=center(10.5)
    slope=0 if near is None or far is None else math.degrees(math.atan2(far-near,5))
    steer=1.9*h
    if e is not None: steer-=6.0*e+0.65*slope
    steer=max(-38,min(38,steer))
    speed=-0.65
    if abs(h)>28: speed=-0.35
    scan=int(t/3)%2
    look=-64 if scan==0 else 64
    return steer,speed,look
